rationale: pre_gat features are provably identical between checkpoints (delta=0.0000, CI=[0.0000, 0.0000]): the encoder is frozen (confirmed by weight comparison), so all differences between goat and robust_goat arise exclusively from GAT and BiLSTM weight changes.
